title: Adic formal smoothness under scalar ring equivalence
statement: Let R and R′ be commutative rings, S a commutative R-algebra, e : R′ ≃+* R a ring equivalence, and n an ideal of S. If S is adically formally smooth over R, then with the transported R′-algebra structure induced by e it is adically formally smooth over R′. The carriers may have independent universes.

    [Algebra R S] (e : R' ≃+* R) (n : Ideal S)

    letI : Algebra R' S := ((algebraMap R S).comp e.toRingHom).toAlgebra

proof.text: Transport the test algebra action along e.symm and construct the R-algebra map with the same underlying ring map and power-vanishing witness.
Apply Algebra.formallySmoothAdic_lift_universe to this lifting problem in the independent test universe.
The resulting lift is R′-linear by e.symm(e(r′)) = r′; its quotient equality is unchanged.
